boundary.description: From the junction of Radcliffe Road and Croft Side, E along Radcliffe Road, Crows Nest to the end of the road and then by a straight line to Bolton – Bury District boundary and S by that boundary and River Irwell, River Croal to Hall Lane. W along Hall Lane and by a bee-line to River Croal, including Crompton Lodge Caravan Park then E, NW along the River Croal and E boundary of the Darcy Level Gravel Pits to Croft Side and its junction with Radcliffe Road.
